project_current_rows.rule: all analysis-present rows; raw outlet; any provider/status; unknown/ND=>0; n>=1; round outlet means BEFORE correlations
project_current_rows.statistics_unit: outlet mean; equal weight per eligible outlet; archive rows used within each mean

verification.coverage_denominator: all selected records (analysis-only for analysis branches)

deepseek_rows.rule: provider=deepseek AND model=deepseek-chat AND analysis present; retain archive versions; ND=>0; per-outlet n>=2 after filters
deepseek_rows.statistics_unit: outlet mean; equal weight per eligible outlet; archive rows used within each mean

verification.coverage_denominator: all selected records (analysis-only for analysis branches)

deepseek_done_rows.rule: deepseek_rows plus explicit analysis_status=done; missing legacy status excluded
deepseek_done_rows.statistics_unit: outlet mean; equal weight per eligible outlet; archive rows used within each mean

verification.coverage_denominator: all selected records (analysis-only for analysis branches)

deepseek_first_eligible_url.rule: filter DeepSeek first, retain first eligible archive line per exact URL; ND=>0; then outlet n>=2
deepseek_first_eligible_url.statistics_unit: outlet mean; equal weight per eligible outlet; archive rows used within each mean

verification.coverage_denominator: all selected records (analysis-only for analysis branches)

deepseek_last_eligible_url.rule: filter DeepSeek first, retain last eligible archive line per exact URL; no inferred analysis timestamp; ND=>0; then n>=2
deepseek_last_eligible_url.statistics_unit: outlet mean; equal weight per eligible outlet; archive rows used within each mean

verification.coverage_denominator: all selected records (analysis-only for analysis branches)

archive_first_url_then_deepseek.rule: retain first archive line per exact URL before filtering DeepSeek; ND=>0; then n>=2
archive_first_url_then_deepseek.statistics_unit: outlet mean; equal weight per eligible outlet; archive rows used within each mean

verification.coverage_denominator: all selected records (analysis-only for analysis branches)

archive_last_url_then_deepseek.rule: retain last archive line per exact URL before filtering DeepSeek; ND=>0; then n>=2
archive_last_url_then_deepseek.statistics_unit: outlet mean; equal weight per eligible outlet; archive rows used within each mean

verification.coverage_denominator: all selected records (analysis-only for analysis branches)

deepseek_ordinal_labels_only.rule: sensitivity only: DeepSeek rows, exclude ND/missing/invalid labels before per-outlet n>=2; no deduplication
deepseek_ordinal_labels_only.statistics_unit: outlet mean; equal weight per eligible outlet; archive rows used within each mean

verification.coverage_denominator: all selected records (analysis-only for analysis branches)
